instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: The substitute teacher was sceptical of whether the lesson plan was interesting enough for her students.
atoms.b: The substitute teacher was ((sceptical)) of whether the lesson plan was interesting enough for her students.

atoms.a: Giving your phone to the teacher is a consequence of texting in class.
atoms.b: Giving your phone to the teacher is a ((consequence)) of texting in class.

atoms.a: What is your perspective on the price of peanut butter?
atoms.b: What is your ((perspective)) on the price of peanut butter?

atoms.a: I have a financial dependence on my parents.
atoms.b: I have a financial ((dependence)) on my parents.

atoms.a: Most schools require parents to vaccinate their children before going to school.
atoms.b: Most schools require parents to ((vaccinate)) their children before going to school.

atoms.a: In order to save up for my trip to France, I had to sacrifice a lot of my free time to work.
atoms.b: In order to save up for my trip to France, I had to ((sacrifice)) a lot of my free time to work.
